metadata.note: Manhattan streetcar seed line, added to prove the multi-city pipeline. Alignment follows present-day Third/Bowery centerline as a first approximation — NOT yet verified against archival sources. Dates and headways are illustrative placeholders pending real research.
metadata.horsecar_audit: 2026-08-24: removed as part of a repo-wide horsecar audit. Removed here: segment 1859-1897 from tar-third-ave-manhattan (the segment labelled the horsecar era; the Third Avenue line now begins at its 1897 electrification). REPO RULE 5: this map shows MECHANICALLY powered rail -- horsecars and mule cars are out of scope, and a line's drawn years must start when it stopped using animals. Notes may still mention the animal era as context. See CLAUDE.md.
metadata.line_label_audit: 2026-08-24: line labels normalised repo-wide to "<operating company>: <line name>" -- the company's common display name (legal suffixes dropped), then the line as a passenger would have known it, or its two terminals where the line carried no advertised name. Long intermediate station lists were reduced to endpoints. For features spanning several operators the company shown is the one that ran the line for most of its drawn years. See CLAUDE.md Rule 6.
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Third_Avenue_Railway -- Wikipedia, "Third Avenue Railway"; lead paragraph confirms this article covers the railroad drawn in this layer. Added 2026-08-24 as a layer-level reference.
metadata.not_yet_sourced: Layer-level reference only. The specific dates, era boundaries and service levels asserted in the segment notes below have NOT been individually verified against it -- they came from earlier research in this repo with no citation recorded. Headways are estimates throughout. Anyone relying on a particular date here should re-check it.
